braincipher.name: BrainCipher
braincipher.description: Brain Cipher emerged in July 2024. Both Windows and Linux variants are available. Brain Cipher using the leaked build of LockBit Black for their operations. The group suspected to have exploited CVE-2023-28252 (Microsoft Windows CLFS Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability). The Ransom demand ranges from $150,000 to $1,00,0000. Demand to be paid with Monero (XMR) cryptocurrency. In 2025, they have shifted their new Negotiation portal to new server with vanity TOR Domain starting with 'brain'.

shadowbyt3$.description: ShadowByt3$ is a ransomware-as-a-service group first observed in October 2025, using multi-method extortion and communicating via Telegram and Tox, with a very small confirmed victim list suggesting it remains in early-stage operation.

akira.name: akira
akira.description: The Akira ransomware group is said to have emerged in March 2023, and there's much speculation about its ties to the former CONTI ransomware group. It's worth noting that with the end of CONTI's operation, several affiliates migrated to independent campaigns such as Royal, BlackBasta, and others. According to some reports, Akira affiliates also work with other ransomware operations, such as Snatch and BlackByte, as an open directory of tools used by an Akira operator was identified, which also had connections to the Snatch ransomware. The first version of the Akira ransomware was written in C…

aurora.name: aurora
aurora.description: Aurora is a ransomware group associated with a multi-purpose Go-based malware distributed by multiple criminal teams from mid-2022, also sold as an infostealer/botnet under the same name on underground forums.

chaos.name: chaos
chaos.description: Chaos is a ransomware-as-a-service operation that emerged in early 2025, likely formed by former BlackSuit/Royal members, offering cross-platform ransomware for Windows, Linux, ESXi, and NAS to affiliates recruited on the RAMP dark web forum, excluding CIS/BRICS countries and hospitals from targeting.

daixin.name: daixin
daixin.description: Daixin Team is a ransomware and data extortion group active since at least June 2022, exclusively targeting the US Healthcare and Public Health sector by encrypting EHR and diagnostic systems and exfiltrating patient data to pressure victims into paying ransoms.

incransom.name: incransom
incransom.description: INC Ransom is a prolific ransomware-as-a-service operation active since July 2023 that systematically targets healthcare, government, education, and manufacturing sectors in North America and Europe, having posted over 200 victims in 2025 alone with no sector off-limits.

metaencryptor.name: metaencryptor
metaencryptor.description: MetaEncryptor is a ransomware group first observed in mid-2023, targeting medium-to-large enterprises in legal, technology, logistics, manufacturing, and finance sectors primarily in the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia, using AES-256/RSA-2048 encryption and double extortion.

netrunner.name: netrunner

articles.description: On 27 September 2026, Citrix published a security bulletin addressing 8 vulnerabilities affecting customer-managed Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway, among which 2 critical unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. articles.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
articles.description: On 12 October 2026, GitLab released versions 19.4.2, 19.3.4 and 19.2.8 of GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE), fixing 24 security issues among which a critical vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. articles.description: On 14 October 2026, Cisco published a security advisory addressing a critical vulnerability affecting the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway. articles.author: CERT-EU Security Advisories

articles.description: On 21 October 2026, GitLab published a security advisory addressing several vulnerabilities among which a critical flaw that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server. The PHP team released the fixes today, 21 October 2026 at 13:30 UTC, in PHP versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Both vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. articles.description: Den nationella CSIRT-funktionen CERT-SE vid NCSC har den under den senaste tiden uppmärksammat ett flertal olika nätfiskekampanjer riktade mot verksamheter i Sverige. articles.description: I veckan deltog John Billow, chef för Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter (NCSC), på en pressträff om cybersäkerhet tillsammans med minister för civilt försvar Carl-Oskar Bohlin, med anledning av den senaste tidens cyberangrepp.

articles.description: Sedan den 11 oktober 2026 har flera kyl- och fryssystem i flera EU-länder drabbats av cybersäkerhetsincidenter. Efter en ny våg av incidenter den 1-2 november uppmanar EU:s cybersäkerhetsaktörer organisationer att omedelbart vidta åtgärder för att minska riskerna i berörda system.

articles.description: NCSC:s incidenthanteringsfunktion CERT-SE har löpande kontakt med berörda aktörer med anledning av de incidenter som drabbat uppkopplade frys- och kylsystem inom dagligvaruhandeln. articles.description: I veckans brev kan du läsa om att den norska nationella säkerhetsmyndigheten (NSM) höjer den nationella cyberrisknivån till hög. Du hittar även information om att sårbarheterna i PHP har lagts till i CISA:s KEV-katalog.

articles.title: Kritisk sårbarhet i Google Brotli
articles.description: En kritisk sårbarhet i Google Brotli har publicerats. Sårbarheten CVE-2026-111497 har fått en CVSS-klassning på 9.2, och möjliggör för en oautentiserad angripare på distans att orsaka överbelastning av system eller potentiellt exekvera godtycklig kod. [1]
articles.author: CERT-SE

articles.title: CERT-SE:s veckobrev v.43
articles.description: I veckans brev kan du läsa om de två kritiska sårbarheterna i programmeringsspråket PHP, som används av en mängd webbplatser över hela världen. articles.title: Kritisk sårbarhet i GitLab CE och EE
